test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In this question, a statement is followed by two conclusions. Which of the two conclusions is/are true with respect to the statement?

**Statement:**

E Z = G 

**Conclusions:** 

I. T D

options.text: Both conclusions I and II are true
Neither conclusion I nor II is true

solution:
Statement:

E Z = G 

Conclusions: 

I. T G and T ≤ Q but there is no direct relationship between G and T.)

II. Z > D ⇒ False (Since D ≤ Q and Q > Z but there is no direct relationship between Z and D.)

Hence, "**Neither conclusion I nor II is true".**
